When the Fire Nation attacked.|Beginning of Wave 50 ([[Pre-MEGA Modes|Pre-MEGA]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Molten Boss''' appears as the final boss in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode. Like most other major bosses, the '''Molten Boss''' moves very slowly, but it has an extremely high amount of health. It also has [[Burn Immunity]], making it immune to burn damage. Additionally, as it is a boss enemy, it is immune to being frozen, slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]], confused by the [[Jester]], damaged by the [[Nuke]]'s fallout, knocked back, slowed down by the [[DJ Booth]] and it is only slowed down by the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] instead of being stunned. It has three abilities: #Its first ability is ''Magma Stomp'' which will create a shockwave and stun towers that are hit. #Its second ability is ''Scythe Slam'' which will summon six random [[enemies]]. In [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]], it summoned in [[Molten Titan (Legacy)|Molten Titan]] and [[Lava]], in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] it summoned [[Molten Titan (Legacy)|Molten Titan]] and [[Molten]], while in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode is only summons in [[Normal]]s. #Its third attack is ''Fireball''. The '''Molten Boss''' throws an explosive fireball at a tower. This sets the targeted tower and all surrounding towers on fire, stunning them for a period of time. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The current version of the '''Molten Boss''' is similar to the third version, except it has a slash across its forehead, with drooping lines leaking from it. |Version 3 |The third version of the '''Molten Boss''' had glowing orange-red skin. It had magma horns on its head as well as magma arms. It had menacing orange eyes and walked slightly hunchback. It had black cobblestone armor, completed with pauldrons, gloves and boots, with a sun insignia imprinted on its torso. It also had metal armbands. Flaming spikes could also seen on its back torso and legs. As it walked, it left behind a lava trail. On its back was an orange-red scythe. |Version 2 |The second version '''Molten Boss''' had glowing orange-red skin. It had magma horns on its head as well as magma arms. It had red eyes. It had black cobblestone armor, complete with pauldrons, armbands, gloves and boots, with a sun insignia imprinted on its torso. Flaming spikes could also seen on its back torso and legs. As it walked, it left behind a lava trail. On its back was an orange-red scythe. |Version 1 |The first version '''Molten Boss''' had glowing orange-red skin. It had magma horns on its head as well as magma arms. It had red eyes and walked slightly hunchback. It had a black cobblestone shirt, with a sun insignia imprinted on its torso. Its legs were also black cobblestone. As it walked, it left behind a lava trail. Smoke was emitted from its torso. It wielded an orange-red scythe. }} ==Strategy== *As with most major bosses, the [[Minigunner]], [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]], [[Turret]] and [[Accelerator]] are recommended for their high DPS. **The [[Commander]] can also be used to boost the firerate of these towers with its ability. **The [[DJ Booth]] can also help increase the range of these towers, decrease their high prices, or increase their damage output, or all three at Level 5. ***You can set a [[DJ Booth]] to its Red track to maximize damage output while also increasing range and decreasing upgrade costs of towers in its range. *You cannot defend your towers against the ''Fireball'' attack if your towers do not have immunity to stun. Additionally, the attack has quite a long range. **You can mitigate its effects by not grouping towers together. **Air-based towers, cliff towers and the [[Medic]] are immune to this attack. Additionally, the [[Gladiator]] and [[Warden]] can block this stun, so long as they do have not blocked another attack within the last few seconds. **A few bait towers can be used to distract the '''Molten Boss''', making it less likely to throw the fireball at other towers. *You can use the [[Medic]] to shield towers from the '''Molten Boss's''' ''Fireball'' and ''Stomp'' stun. *The [[Toxic Gunner]] cannot be used to slow this down. **Stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] can only slow it down instead of stunning it. Similarly, freezing towers can also only slow it down instead of stunning it. **The [[Jester]]'s confusion cannot confuse it, but its ice bombs can still slow it down. **It cannot be slowed down by the [[DJ Booth]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} MoltenBoss1.png|Third version (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) MoltenBoss2.png|Second version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) MoltenBoss0.png|First version (30 June 2019 – 13 October 2019) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMoltenBoss.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} 8910f29d0fd85e97b4424a980dbd9037.jpg|'''Molten Boss''' on the game thumbnail. 518a03eb029c788da017123a8d77fbd3.png|'''Molten Boss''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} THumb2.jpg|'''Molten Boss''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} OFFICIAL Tower Defense Simulator Trailer 2|'''Molten Boss''' in the game trailer. MoltenBossIconIG.png|'''Molten Boss''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Until the [[Gravekeeper]] was added, this was the only regular major boss in the game. **However, the [[Swordmaster]] predates the '''Molten Boss''' by six days. *The '''Molten Boss''' used to spawn [[Molten]]s instead of [[Lava]]s in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode. *There was once a glitch where you could place a tower on the body of the '''Molten Boss''' when it was killed. *The '''Molten Boss''' was originally the logo of Paradoxum Games, the group that owns Tower Defense Simulator. *Before the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], the phrase "''Everything changed... When the Fire Nation attacked.''", which was played before the '''Molten Boss''' appeared, was a reference to the opening of the show ''[[wp:Avatar:_The_Last_Airbender|Avatar: The Last Airbender]]''. *The magma horns on the '''Molten Boss''' are a retextured version of the {{RLinkC|215718515|Fiery Horns Of The Netherworld}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The pauldrons worn by the '''Molten Boss''' are a retextured version of the {{RLinkC|3267573976|Crushing Crystals Pauldrons}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]]'s dialogue before the '''Molten Boss''' appeared called the '''Molten Boss''' the [[Molten Titan (Legacy)|Molten Titan]], likely due to a developer oversight. **Given the fact that the "Boss" suffix tends to be used more often for enemies who are stronger versions of weaker enemies (For instance, [[Speedy Boss]] being the name of stronger versions of the weaker [[Speedy]] enemy), the name "Molten Titan" seems to be more fitting for the '''Molten Boss''' and vice versa. It's entirely possible that the two respective enemies' names were swapped in development, whether it be on purpose or accidental. *Prior to the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], the '''Molten Boss''' had two additional abilities. ** The first was ''Scythe Raise'' which healed between 350 and 735 health over a period of 3.5 seconds. **The second was ''Scythe Swing''. The '''Molten Boss''' would swing its scythe, stunning all towers in a 15-stud radius. *The '''Molten Boss''' appeared alongside the legacy [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] on the old "You Lost" screen. *The '''Molten Boss'''' third final wave music is the same song as [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WP5RnxYbSXo Battle Royale] by Alec Koff. **The current theme is a remix of the same song. ==Update History== {{Scroll|text= *'''30 June 2019''' -
